summary: Configured opsadmin on node1 with the given SSH public key and enforced key-based SSH authentication (PasswordAuthentication no, ChallengeResponseAuthentication no, PubkeyAuthentication yes, account password-locked). Verified sshd rejects password auth and accepts only pubkey/gssapi. Restarted node1 via native reboot, confirmed boot_id changed, and verified all configuration and opsadmin data persisted after restart.
actions_performed: Created opsadmin user on node1 with home dir and locked password
Installed the provided ed25519 public key into /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys with 700/600 perms
Edited /etc/ssh/sshd_config to set PubkeyAuthentication yes, PasswordAuthentication no, ChallengeResponseAuthentication no
Cleaned up duplicate directive lines introduced by an earlier failed script attempt
Validated sshd_config syntax with sshd -t and restarted sshd
Verified password auth is rejected and only publickey/gssapi offered via a local ssh attempt
Captured pre-restart boot_id and service/data health baseline
Issued a native reboot on node1, polled until exec was available again
Confirmed boot_id changed post-restart and re-verified sshd health, opsadmin account, authorized_keys, and password-auth rejection

evidence.requirement: opsadmin user exists with the specified public key installed
evidence.summary: id opsadmin and cat authorized_keys show the exact ed25519 key present before and after restart

evidence.requirement: SSH key-based authentication required (password auth disabled)
evidence.summary: sshd_config shows PasswordAuthentication no / PubkeyAuthentication yes / ChallengeResponseAuthentication no; live ssh attempts with PreferredAuthentications=password are rejected with 'Permission denied (publickey,gssapi-keyex,gssapi-with-mic)' both before and after restart
sshd -t passes and systemctl is-active sshd reports active pre- and post-restart
Captured boot_id e9250ad1-c4f0-4bec-b58e-4e30255a8dcf, sshd active status, and opsadmin/authorized_keys state before reboot

evidence.requirement: Restart acknowledged and node became unreachable then reachable again
evidence.summary: Reboot command acknowledged asynchronously, subsequent execs timed out while node was down, then exec succeeded again once node1 came back

evidence.requirement: Changed boot identity proves an actual restart occurred
evidence.summary: boot_id changed from e9250ad1-c4f0-4bec-b58e-4e30255a8dcf to fe19be03-fca5-42c7-879d-fdeaf4e609bb, and uptime -s shows a new boot time of 2026-09-29 08:48:29

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of required configuration and data
evidence.summary: After restart: sshd active, sshd -t OK, opsadmin account present with same authorized_keys content, password locked, and password auth still rejected by live ssh test
